content.value: The vanilla [[item/minecraft:blast_furnace|Blast Furnace]] serves as the [[article/foundry|Foundry]]. Its current role is salvaging eligible metal equipment. It has no unique material-production recipes yet.
Select eligible equipment to inspect its actual material return before committing. Gear with valuable upgrades can require confirmation; shift-click behavior is retained.
[[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]], Netherite and leather equipment are not metal-smelting inputs. Use the supported recycling operations at the [[article/crafting_table|Crafting Table]] instead.
Future [[article/foundry|Foundry]] material recipes will be separate from the [[article/kiln|Kiln]] and cooking stations.
